title: AdjointFlow: Accelerating Scientific Inverse Problems with Physics-Based Transport
abstract: arXiv:2611.13389v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inverse problems are ubiquitous across scientific applications ranging from seismic imaging to astrophysics to nondestructive testing, yet classical solvers often struggle with nonconvexity and repeated evaluations of expensive physical models. Diffusion models can amortize this computation offline, but largely data-driven conditional models underutilize known physics and suffer from ill-conditioned transport maps when the target distribution is concentrated. Plug-and-play (PnP) methods explicitly leverage the physical model to guide a learned prior, improving data consistency but reintroducing costly iterative computations. We instead propose AdjointFlow, a framework built on stochastic interpolants that injects the known physics into the generative transport itself. translated_title: AdjointFlow：基于物理的传输加速科学逆问题求解
translated_abstract: 逆问题在从地震成像、天体物理到无损检测等科学应用中无处不在，然而经典求解器往往难以应对非凸性问题以及对昂贵物理模型的重复评估。扩散模型虽然可以在离线阶段摊销这些计算，但主要依赖数据驱动的条件模型未能充分利用已知物理知识，并且在目标分布高度集中时会受到病态传输映射的困扰。即插即用（PnP）方法显式地利用物理模型来引导学习到的先验，改善了数据一致性，但又重新引入了代价高昂的迭代计算。我们转而提出AdjointFlow，这是一个建立在随机插值基础上的框架，将已知物理直接注入生成式传输本身。我们设计了一种数据相关的、基于伴随方法的初始化来减少到目标分布的传输距离，并修改传输速度使其在端点分布……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出AdjointFlow框架，通过随机插值将已知物理知识注入生成式传输过程本身，并利用基于伴随方法的数据相关初始化减少传输距离，从而加速科学逆问题的求解。
en_tdlr: AdjointFlow injects known physics into the generative transport itself via stochastic interpolants, using data-dependent adjoint-based initialization to reduce transport distance and accelerate scientific inverse problem solving.
